subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB319 LANDED, after kb/Work PB316 (landed). ONE SITE, FULL ANTECEDENT. The rule (cite.py --check 14.9.27.3, both its leading conjunct and its two disjuncts: OK, rule 8) is a syntax rule of the OPEN STATEMENT about file-name-1, which 14.9.27.2's general format defines as that statement's operand; 12.4.5.15.3 has exactly ONE general rule and NO syntax rules, so SR8 is the standard's only source of a LOCK MODE requirement anywhere. It was enforced in TWO places. The second copy, in DataBinder.BindFileControl, fired off the SELECT clause alone and had to DROP the antecedent, because a file control entry sees no OPEN statement and the I-O-CONTROL paragraph is not bound until after it. That copy is DELETED (the extraction IS the fix), leaving StatementValidation.CheckOpenSharingAllOther, called from BindOpen once per file-name, as SR8's only site; its two disjuncts collapse onto the effective sharing mode 'sharing ?? file.Sharing' (14.9.27.4 GR23), which after PB316 is the file's OWN open group's phrase. MEASURED BEFORE AND AFTER on this worktree's cobol.exe at --std 2002. sr8ovr.cob (SELECT F1 ... SHARING WITH ALL OTHER, no LOCK MODE, and OPEN OUTPUT SHARING WITH NO OTHER F1) was REJECTED COBOL1512 at the SELECT line 6 and now compiles and runs. sr8none.cob (the same SELECT, the file NEVER opened) was REJECTED and now compiles and runs. sr8dup.cob (the same SELECT, plain OPEN OUTPUT F1) drew the SAME rule TWICE in two spellings and now draws exactly ONE diagnostic, from the OPEN. sr8phr.cob (no SHARING clause; OPEN OUTPUT SHARING WITH ALL OTHER F1) is still rejected - disjunct 2 intact. THE LEADING CONJUNCT IS NOW MODELLED AND IS NOT VACUOUS. 'When file-name-1 is not subject to an APPLY COMMIT clause' reads FileModel.SubjectToApplyCommit, set by DataBinder.BindIoControl from the 12.4.6.3 APPLY COMMIT clause. The row's earlier claim that the exemption was harmless because APPLY COMMIT is a parse error does NOT hold: the clause parsed and was then DECLINED (COBOL1709, since retired: kb/Work PB3338 and PB3340 accept it for every file), and that descriptor was PermissiveInert, so under --permissive it was a warning and the program compiled - measured, an APPLY COMMIT file with SHARING WITH ALL OTHER and no LOCK MODE was rejected COBOL1512 by BOTH sites at --std 2023 --permissive and now compiles. The exemption is load-bearing rather than decorative: 12.4.5.9.3 SR1 forbids writing a LOCK MODE clause 'for a file that is the subject of an APPLY COMMIT clause', so without it SR8 would demand the one clause another rule forbids. WITNESSES. conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/pb319_sr8_antecedent pins the antecedent falsified in both compilable ways (a non-ALL sharing phrase on the OPEN; a file never opened) and prints Table 19 statuses - OVR=00, RIV1=61 (row SHARING WITH ALL OTHER / INPUT against column 'sharing with no other' = Unsuccessful open, 9.1.13.9 item 1 a), RIV2=00 after the conflicting connector closes - so a compiler that passed it by IGNORING the sharing phrase would print 00 where 61 is required; it does not compile at all on the pre-fix compiler. conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/sharing-all-no-lockmode is RE-POINTED: it used to have no OPEN statement anywhere and so pinned the over-rejection as intended behaviour (a green test holding the gap open), and now carries an OPEN with no sharing phrase, which is disjunct 1, with the OPEN-site diagnostic as its .err. conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/pb316-open-sharing-all-no-lockmode covers disjunct 2. conformance-test:OpenSharingLockModeTests carries the two assertions no .cob corpus can make - that ONE violation draws exactly ONE COBOL1512 (a substring-matching .err is blind to a duplicate, which is how the second copy survived), and the APPLY COMMIT exemption with its falsifying control arm (the same program minus the I-O-CONTROL paragraph is still rejected). Design: docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D13. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 2002 / 2014 / 2023 - the SHARING clause, the OPEN sharing phrase and LOCK MODE are Annex A.4.7 items and are gated out at 1985 (COBOL0900); Annex E records no 2014-to-2023 change. retired-witness: conformance-test:OpenSharingLockModeTests.WithoutTheApplyCommitClause_TheSameProgramIsRejectedUnderPermissive (renamed: the clause is accepted for the RELATIVE file the program now names (kb/Work PB3338), so the test no longer needs --permissive)
